correctness.rationale: Cyclic difference identifies real Lip(C_n)/constants with the zero-sum subspace of l-infinity. Convolution commutation gives exact kernel a=(2/n)cos for non-Nyquist frequencies. The row duality sup_{sum g=0,|g|<=1} a.g=min_c sum|a-c| follows by median subgradient with attainable zero-sum signs. Exact arithmetic of odd sample medians and even absolute cosine sums leads to four complete cases, including Nyquist correction. Monotonicity of x/sin x and strict x cot x/y cos²y/sin y inequalities prove a unique global 4/3 at effective period six; absence of zero cosine values forces sign-pattern extremizers. Taylor expansions give corrections. Actual standalone verifier exhaustively checks 63 cycle-harmonic pairs by independent cube-vertex enumeration, exact-rational six-cycle 4/3, 298 median formulas, 3540 gcd collapses and phase asymptotics. Finite checks are corroboration only.
